The '''Delphanian Face Gang''' was a prison gang active onboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. At one time its leader was [[Sixtus Cleft]], but following his death it was taken over by the [[Delphanian]] [[Aur Myss]].
